evals.prompt: Retrieve active alerts from https://dev.azure.com/devdiv/DevDiv/_componentGovernance/233426?_a=alerts&typeId=38309165&alerts-view-option=active and explain how you know they belong to this report.
evals.expected_output: Uses Azure CLI authentication, discovers the ComponentGovernance resource-area host, calls the exact preview Alerts route, and filters value records by active top-level state plus active stateDetails for snapshotTypeId 38309165.

evals.prompt: Remediate the actionable Component Governance dependency alerts in this pnpm monorepo and prepare the change for review.
evals.expected_output: Checks all independently owned lockfiles, prefers direct or parent upgrades before narrow overrides, regenerates with pnpm 8.6.12, validates affected packages, documents justified dismissals, and does not commit generated CG reports.

evals.prompt: CG still shows an indirect package after I updated the lockfiles. Can we dismiss it?
evals.expected_output: Requires explicit CG guidance and verified runtime/reachability conditions, distinguishes local lock evidence from server rescan state, and does not call a guessed dismissal API.

evals.prompt: Remediate CG alerts when the required Microsoft package feed exposes only one of two fast-uri fixes, lacks the fast-xml-parser fix, and excluded packages own independent pnpm lockfiles. fast-uri 3.1.2 resolves in the root, mcp-server, and sdk lockfiles; Hono 1.19.14 and fast-xml-parser 5.9.3 resolve only in the root lockfile. Regeneration also rewrites many ms-feed backend aliases.
evals.expected_output: Checks each advisory-approved version on https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/ before editing; proves dependency ownership before changing the owning manifests; applies only available fixed versions in all affected lockfiles; does not dismiss alerts merely because a fix is unavailable; uses pnpm 8.6.12 install rather than add or update, with --ignore-workspace for excluded standalone packages; parses and normalizes lockfile package identities and importers to prove alias-only churn; validates frozen installs, affected builds and tests; and records any compliant-browser dismissal blocker.

evals.prompt: Resolve a CG remediation PR conflict where dev upgraded ajv, yaml, rollup, and follow-redirects in two standalone pnpm lockfiles, while the PR upgraded fast-uri. Regenerating through the required proxy rewrites thousands of ms-feed aliases, and one unrelated optional tarball returns 404.
evals.expected_output: Preserves dev as the lockfile baseline and retains the PR manifests; does not accept ours or theirs wholesale; tries pnpm 8.6.12 install with --ignore-workspace through the proxy; permits only a minimal semantic conflict merge using PNPM-generated or previously frozen-install-validated nodes; verifies normalized package identities and importer maps as YAML; checks the native exit code instead of treating an optional fetch warning as failure; and runs frozen installs before completing the merge.
